recognize_zh: 箭頭指向一個核被一道淺溝分隔、呈雙核或核分葉的前驅細胞（發育不良的紅血球系細胞），周圍則有多個染色質細緻、胞質深藍的大型芽細胞與核形不規則的紅血球前驅細胞，呈現芽細胞增加合併發育不良。
features: Arrowed cell with a nucleus divided by a cleft, suggesting binucleation/nuclear lobation of a dysplastic erythroid precursor
Increased large blasts with fine chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Erythroid precursors with irregular nuclear contours and nuclear budding
Scattered small lymphocytes and late normoblasts
Background red cells with poikilocytes and a smudged cell at right
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows increased large blasts with fine chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm. The arrow highlights a precursor with a nucleus divided by a distinct cleft, consistent with binucleation or abnormal lobation, and additional erythroid precursors show irregular nuclear contours and budding. Late normoblasts and small lymphocytes are admixed. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with dysplastic changes, compatible with AML with myelodysplasia-related changes when blast and multilineage dysplasia thresholds are confirmed.

ddx.vs: Differs by blast count below 20% on a 500-cell marrow differential.
PEL shows >80% erythroid cells with ≥30% proerythroblasts, whereas this field contains myeloblasts and mixed lineages.
Megaloblastic change can produce binucleate erythroid precursors but lacks increased myeloblasts.
